description: A dark oil-painting style scene of a large grey battleship with two funnels and a crescent-and-star flag on its mast, firing its guns amid fireballs and black smoke over a choppy sea at dusk. Behind it, a harbour town on a hillside is burning, with smoke rising from the quayside and small white buildings and a minaret-like tower visible. Small figures stand on the deck, and splashes from near-miss shells dot the water. No text or frame is visible, and the painting fills the whole image.
